sections.description:
Farjana Reading Progress Bar is the most feature-rich and user-friendly reading progress plugin for WordPress! Enhance your readers’ experience with real-time progress tracking, accurate reading time estimation, and delightful completion celebrations.

Perfect for bloggers, news websites, educational platforms, and any content-heavy site looking to boost engagement and improve user experience!

✨ Key Features

Reading Progress Bar:
* 📊 Smooth Real-time Progress Bar – Updates as readers scroll
* 🎨 Fully Customizable Colors – Match your brand perfectly
* 📍 Flexible Positioning – Top, bottom, or custom position
* 💫 Smooth Animations – Professional and engaging
* 🎯 Glassmorphism Design – Modern blurred background effects

Smart Reading Time Calculator:
* ⏱️ Accurate Time Estimation – Based on Words Per Minute (WPM)
* 📊 Live Progress Percentage – Shows how much is read
* 🕐 Estimated Finish Time – When readers will complete
* 🔢 Customizable WPM – Adjust for your audience
* 📝 Custom Text Labels – Personalize all messages

Interactive Celebration System:
* 🎊 “Shukriya!” Completion Popup – Beautiful reward when done
* 🎭 Smart Mood Detection – AI-powered content analysis
* 😊 Personalized Messages – Happy/Sad/Neutral responses
* ✨ Confetti Animation – Engaging visual celebration
* 🌐 Multi-language Support – Bengali & English

Advanced Customization:
* 🎨 Color Picker – Bar, text, background colors
* 📏 Size Controls – Bar thickness, font size
* 🔤 Typography Options – Font styles and sizes
* ⚙️ Border Radius – Rounded or sharp corners
* 💫 Hover Effects – Interactive animations
* 🎯 Box Shadow – Beautiful depth effects

Post Type Support:
* ✅ Blog Posts
* ✅ Pages
* ✅ Custom Post Types
* ✅ BBPress Forums
* ✅ Reports and more

🎯 Perfect For

  • Bloggers – Keep readers engaged and reduce bounce rate

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Search for “Farjana Reading Progress Bar”
  3. Click “Install Now”
  4. Click “Activate”
  5. Go to Settings → Reading Time Settings to configure

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file and click “Install Now”
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Configure settings under Settings → Reading Time Settings

After Activation

  1. Visit Settings → Reading Time Settings

    • Set your preferred WPM (default: 200)
    • Choose which post types to display on
    • Customize text labels
    • Enable/disable features

  2. Visit Settings → Design Settings

    • Pick your progress bar color
    • Adjust bar thickness and position
    • Customize reading time box colors
    • Enable hover effects and shadows

  3. Create or edit a post to see the plugin in action!
sections.faq:
Does it work with all WordPress themes?

Yes! The plugin is designed to work with any WordPress theme that follows WordPress coding standards.

Can I customize the colors?

Absolutely! You can customize:
* Progress bar color
* Reading time box background
* Text colors
* Border colors
* And more!

Will it slow down my website?

No! The plugin is extremely lightweight and optimized. It adds minimal CSS and JavaScript, with zero impact on performance.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes! The plugin is fully responsive and works perfectly on all screen sizes – mobile, tablet, and desktop.

Can I disable it on certain post types?

Yes! You can choose which post types to display the reading progress on from the settings page.

How is reading time calculated?

Reading time is calculated based on Words Per Minute (WPM). The default is 200 WPM, but you can adjust it in settings.

What is the “Shukriya” celebration popup?

It’s a beautiful reward popup that appears when readers finish your article, thanking them with personalized messages and confetti animation!

How does mood detection work?

The plugin analyzes your content for emotional keywords and displays appropriate messages (happy for positive content, empathetic for sad content).

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes! The plugin is translation-ready and currently supports English and Bengali, with more languages coming soon.

Does it track user data?

No! The plugin is 100% privacy-friendly and doesn’t collect, store, or transmit any personal data.

Can I hide the reading time but keep the progress bar?

Yes! You can independently enable/disable the reading time display and progress bar.

Is there a pro version?

A pro version with advanced features is coming soon! Stay tuned for announcements.

How do I get support?

Visit the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org or contact us directly through our website.
